data.one_liner: A Flutter package providing a user interface for solving crossword puzzles.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable crossword puzzle widget for Flutter applications. Allows users to interactively solve puzzles, select letters, manage clues, and view animations like letter reveals and pop effects.
use_when: You want to add crossword puzzle functionality to a Flutter application.
You need an interactive word search or crossword grid with customizable lines and clues.
avoid_when: Your application does not involve crossword puzzles or word search grids.
strengths: Interactive crossword puzzle UI with pan and letter selection.
Supports clue management, custom line decorations, and animations.
Multi-platform support including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Niche package limited exclusively to crossword and word puzzle interfaces.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the package as a dependency in your pubspec.yaml file.
data.minimal_example:
Crossword(
   letters: const [
       ["F", "L", "U", "T", "T", "E", "R"],
       ["R", "M", "I", "O", "P", "U", "I"],
   ],
   spacing: const Offset(30, 30),
   onLineDrawn: (List<String> words) {},
   hints: const ["FLUTTER"],
)
